$comment: Ship gate: pass@1 (interactive-assist). The runner's two deterministic gates (catalog membership pre-call, column-count post-call) are exercised by case-104/105.

cases.source: captured ask class: coverage gaps / weekly book review
cases.prompt: Which of Leland Rayner's accounts have no meetings on the calendar for the next two weeks?
cases.expected_behavior: account-object packet with owner filter + upcoming_meetings next_14_days; zero-filter applied client-side; shortlist presented sorted by engagement level; window stated.

cases.prompt: How many meetings with Directors or VPs did Leland Rayner have last quarter?
cases.expected_behavior: user-object packet, email filter, meetings_with_director_vp_exec_last_quarter; answers with the NUMBER and window — no gratuitous table.

cases.source: generic reporting replacement (MCP does not replace reporting)
cases.prompt: Build me a table of open opportunities closing this quarter with their engagement levels.
cases.expected_behavior: opportunity-object packet with close-date epoch-ms range filter; --html render produced; provenance line shows object + row count.

cases.source: the silent-drop trap (docs contain fabricated slugs)
cases.prompt: (maintainer check) Run a packet containing ootb_account_health_score.
cases.expected_behavior: run_query.py exits BEFORE calling the API, naming the unvalidated slug; nothing is presented.

cases.prompt: (maintainer check) A validated column is disabled in the tenant and the API drops it.
cases.expected_behavior: run_query.py exits with COLUMN DROP after the call; no partial result is delivered or summarized.

cases.prompt: Pull sales data for Leland Rayner.
cases.expected_behavior: sales-data-pull handles the canned 360; explorer stays inactive.

cases.source: skill boundary (narratives are not in the export API)
cases.prompt: What are the risks and next steps on Leland's top accounts?
cases.expected_behavior: Hands off to sales-insights (MCP); never fabricates narrative from metric columns.

cases.prompt: Who are the senior people engaged at account X?
cases.expected_behavior: Explains account-scoped people questions go to sales-insights (get_engaged_people); does not attempt unvalidated person filters.

cases.prompt: Show me Leland's meetings from last week and who attended each.
cases.expected_behavior: Uses rest_query.py activities-meeting/participants (validated params only: last-n-days, activity-uid); maps the seller via team-members client-side; joins on activity uid; presents a table with attendee title/seniority; states the window; never invents attendees.

cases.prompt: How has engagement with <contact> trended over the last quarter?
cases.expected_behavior: Reads contact-engagement via the catalog with contact-id (long People.ai id, resolved from /contacts — never crm_id); presents the weekly 0-100 series with dates; no fabricated interpolation.

cases.prompt: Pull the actual email text Leland sent DeepHow last month.
cases.expected_behavior: Refuses with the retention explanation (bodies deleted by design) — offers activity metadata + participants instead; never implies bodies are pullable.
